name: q15_multi_hop_existence_with_local_paths
description: existence filter reaches regions through the 2-hop refunds.customer.home_region path. Both refunds and shipments have two ways to reach regions (direct 'region' and customer.home_region), so the local application path is named explicitly in local_paths; without it compilation must refuse rather than guess. Selects customers whose refund chain lands in home region north.
